sara: Quick UX review — compact streaming affordance + prompt library placement. Thinking inline toolbar vs floating modal for edits. PTAL. maya: I prefer inline toolbar on desktop (less context shift). Floating modal feels heavy for small edits. :thinking: lin: @maya agree re desktop. Main a11y problem is focus jump when stream finishes — keyboard users lose where they were. We should preserve focus to the message container and expose stop/regenerate via keyboard shortcuts. jamie: What about a persistent mini stop/regenerate pill in the composer rail? small tap target, keyboardable, aria-labels. Also token counter should be outside streaming overlay so VoiceOver reads updates reliably. ioscar: Edge case: when prompt library opens as a drawer it covers the right-side token counter. We either float token counter over drawer or move token counter to top bar when drawer is open. maya: Proposal: token counter has a "compact" mode — small badge in composer top-right. When prompt library opens, token counter collapses into header. For streaming updates use aria-live="polite" on the counter. lin: Spec for keyboard: Enter to send, Esc to stop (when streaming), Shift+Enter to newline. Focus handling: after stop, focus should go to last generated message. I'll add a11y notes and a focus flow diagram. jamie: Quick code example for aria: ```
Tokens: 1,234
``` Make sure stop-btn only gets programmatic focus if the user triggered stop via keyboard (avoid surprising mouse users). sara: Copy tweaks: 'Stop' vs 'Pause' — 'Stop' is clearer. For regenerate microcopy: 'Regenerate response' (full) vs 'Retry' (short). Leaning towards 'Regenerate' for clarity. ioscar: :thumbsup: Agree. Also add a tiny loading shimmer for partial tokens so users know the stream is active (and not stuck). maya: Accessibility nits: color contrast on token badge in compact mode is borderline in our current theme. Suggest using #0B67B2 on white or adding a 2px stroke to improve readability. lin: Performance note: if token counter updates every token it can cause layout thrash. Debounce visual updates to ~200ms, keep internal accurate counter for billing/telemetry. jamie: Action items: - maya -> high-fi mock showing inline toolbar + compact token badge (due Tue) - lin -> keyboard & focus spec, debounce details - oscar -> prompt library overlay variants + accessibility checklist - sara -> finalize copy and confirm on Monday I'll add a checklist to the PR template for UX/a11y review. sara: Thanks all — can we sync tomorrow 9am PT? If not, drop mocks in #design-review. :calendar:
